title: NOIR
shortDescription: Autonomous software reliability and chaos engineering platform with a high-speed Go CLI agent, Docker fault injection, and real-time telemetry streaming.
fullDescription: NOIR is an enterprise-grade autonomous reliability and chaos engineering platform designed for containerized microservices. Engineered with a zero-dependency, statically-linked Go CLI agent (<8ms startup latency, ~9MB memory footprint), NOIR combines deterministic Docker fault injection (Linux Traffic Control netem, cgroup CPU/memory stressors, and container lifecycle) with continuous steady-state HTTP health probing. It enforces strict sample-count statistical gating (P95/P99 latency, 3-sigma anomaly spike detection), validates Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) against consecutive healthy confirmations, and streams live telemetry over Django Channels WebSockets to an interactive React 19 dashboard with automated resilience scoring and remediation roadmaps.
features: Native Go CLI Agent (<8ms startup, ~9MB memory footprint, zero-dependency binary with cross-compilation for Linux, macOS & Windows)
Embedded local OAuth server (127.0.0.1:53145) & dual-layer OS Keyring / ~/.noir/credentials.json storage
Lynx AST Profiler with parallel goroutine directory scanning for sub-50ms tech-stack & Docker container discovery
Multi-stack automated test runner supporting Pytest, Django, Jest, Vitest, Go test, Cargo test, and Maven
Deterministic Docker fault injection (CPU/memory stress, netem latency & packet loss, container restarts/stops)
Failsafe automated rollback & kernel cleanup guaranteed even upon interruption or unexpected crash
Continuous steady-state HTTP health probing with sub-millisecond RTO measurement
Strict sample-count confidence gating (P95/P99 latency, 3-sigma anomaly classification, burst-failure tracking)
Algorithmic resilience scoring (0–100 scale, letter grades A–F, and formal hypothesis verification)
Real-time bi-directional WebSocket telemetry streaming to a React 19 + Recharts terminal dashboard
One-line automated shell & PowerShell installers (`curl -fsSL https://noir.amalskumar.dev/install.sh | bash`)

title: Velora
shortDescription: Digital art commission marketplace in neo-brutalist style.
fullDescription: A neo-brutalist marketplace connecting clients with digital artists. Features client & artist portals, a secure Razorpay escrow payment flow, visual order tracking pipelines, and dispute resolution systems.

title: BotFence
shortDescription: Universal WordPress anti-spam & autonomous bot defense engine without visual puzzles.
fullDescription: An enterprise-grade, zero-configuration WordPress security and anti-spam plugin engineered to block automated spam, credential stuffing, and bot attacks across all forms without annoying visual CAPTCHAs or third-party subscriptions. Built with a modular adapter architecture supporting 10+ major form builders, BotFence combines dynamic rotating honeypots and HMAC-SHA256 tokens with server-side composite risk scoring (0–100), atomic rate limiting, full page-caching compatibility via REST/AJAX token hydration, and an executive threat defense analytics dashboard.
features: Dynamic rotating honeypot traps & HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic tokens
Multi-signal composite risk scoring engine (0–100 scale)
Zero-configuration adapter support across 10+ WordPress form builders
Atomic IP and form-level rate limiting with SHA-256 privacy hashing
Interactive Threat Defense & Analytics dashboard with CSV audit exports
Fully tested test suite with 84 automated PHPUnit tests & 444 assertions

title: Copper
shortDescription: A custom interpreted programming language built in C.
fullDescription: An educational interpreter built in C to explore compiler design concepts. Includes a custom lexer, recursive descent parser constructing an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), and a visitor-pattern evaluation engine.

title: Paralax
shortDescription: IoT dual-button push-to-talk AI voice translator edge device with real-time bidirectional WebSocket streaming.
fullDescription: Paralax is an IoT push-to-talk two-way voice translation edge device and cloud platform. Powered by an ESP32 microcontroller with digital I2S audio peripherals (INMP441 MEMS mic & MAX98357A amp), it streams raw 16 kHz PCM audio over bidirectional WebSockets to a Node.js/Hono gateway. The pipeline chains Groq Whisper STT, LLaMA-3.3-70B translation, and Edge-TTS for sub-500ms voice-to-voice translation, paired with a React 19 fleet telemetry dashboard and automated provider fallback resilience.
features: Dual-button physical push-to-talk interface for seamless two-way dialogue
Full-duplex WebSocket audio streaming removing edge SRAM buffer limits
Sub-500ms pipeline powered by Groq Whisper, LLaMA 3.3, and Edge-TTS
Pure digital I2S audio architecture (INMP441 MEMS mic & MAX98357A amp)
Multi-provider automated fallback resilience (Groq Cloud & xAI Grok)
Real-time React 19 fleet management & live telemetry dashboard
role: IoT Systems Architect & Full Stack Engineer

title: SwiftRide
shortDescription: A modern, full-stack taxi booking & ridesharing platform.
fullDescription: A comprehensive Django-based taxi-booking and ridesharing web application connecting passengers and drivers dynamically. Features a real-time fare calculator, driver portal, passenger portal, and an analytics dashboard.

title: Momentum
shortDescription: RPG-style gamified habit tracker & life simulator.
fullDescription: A premium, web-based gamified productivity platform that turns building habits and completing daily tasks into an engaging RPG experience. Rewards consistency with Gold and XP, while penalizing missed tasks with HP damage.

title: Real-Time WebSocket Game Engine
shortDescription: High-concurrency full-stack multiplayer gaming platform with real-time lobbies and chat.
fullDescription: A high-performance, full-stack multiplayer gaming platform featuring a decoupled Django-React architecture. Utilizing Django Channels, Daphne ASGI server, and Redis as a message broker, the platform powers sub-second gameplay synchronization and real-time user presence tracking. Secure custom JWT authentication protects the global chat lobbies and private game rooms, with persistent user statistics and chat history stored in PostgreSQL.

title: Make.md
shortDescription: An ultra-elegant, high-performance, and distraction-free Markdown Editor built for the modern web.
fullDescription: A premium, minimalist Markdown Editor featuring a dual-mode layout, responsive Zen writing experience, modular workspace controls, native drag-and-drop file importer, and a unified dark/light mode engine.

title: Portfolio
shortDescription: A premium developer portfolio website with glassmorphism.
fullDescription: A premium personal developer portfolio website designed with a custom Lavender Cherry Blossom aesthetic. It features glassmorphism UI elements, dark/light mode toggle, scroll-linked animations, falling petals on the home page, interactive 3D perspective cards, and timeline visualizations.
